name: Jobber
summary: Field service software for home-service and trade businesses, with quotes, scheduling, invoicing and payments in one app.
differentiator: The quoting features climb the tiers. Core ($29 per month billed annually) gives professional quotes, templates and signature approvals, but auto-drafted quotes need Connect ($99) and optional add-ons and markups need Grow ($149). Each plan includes a set number of users (1, 5, 10 and 15) and extra users are $29 a month, so a growing crew moves up a tier mainly for seats.
pricing: Core $29, Connect $99, Grow $149 and Plus $399 per month billed annually; $49, $139, $199 and $499 on monthly billing. Included users are 1, 5, 10 and 15; extra users are $29 per month on every plan. A 14-day trial gives full access to Grow features, no card needed. Annual billing saves up to 25 percent.
category: Quoting and invoicing for small contractors
whoPays: Subscriber pays per plan plus per extra user
bestFor: Owner-operators and small crews that quote homeowners and want quoting, scheduling and invoicing in one place.
skipIf: You respond to invitations to bid or need to level subcontractor quotes; it has no bid management.
